report.summary: PROP trader T-X1012-03 (PROP-EQ, not a registered market maker on SYN.A, typical order size 500) placed one BUY limit of 27,591 at 9993 (11.8x avg top-5 depth of 2,338; 4 ticks below the 9997 bid) at 15:15:41.700. 3.3s later he sent a SELL market order of 1,183 that filled 9997-9994, and he cancelled the whole buy 480 ms after that, with no fills on it. The pattern is one-sided (cancel_symmetry 0, same_side_fill_qty 0), and no event or risk event was recorded. No accepted legitimate explanation is supported, so feature (a) cannot be ruled out. Feature (b) is weak: price_move_ticks 0, reversion 0, and the sale walked down the book on its own. It happened once (repetitions 1) and there is no prior alert history. Proposed ESCALATE, not DRAFT_STOR, because the benefit is not shown and the cycle did not repeat.

report.what_would_change_my_mind: I would propose CLOSE_FP if the trader can show the 27,591 buy was a genuine bid that he deliberately priced below the touch, for example a documented client or hedge instruction, or a corrected order of typical size that fills outside the padded window. I would propose DRAFT_STOR if a longer look-back finds the same large-bid-then-sell cycle repeated with a favourable price move.
memory_used: Desk PROP-EQ feedback on A-261016-0003 (l1.analyst): 'a cancel within 200 ms of an unscheduled news item on the name is a news reaction ... Treat as CLOSE_FP unless the sale follows the news.' This does not apply here: there is no market event in the window (E8), only 2 market-wide cancels in the second before the cancel (E6), and the cancel came 480 ms after the trader's own sale, not after news.
